english.note: Use 發生 as the all-purpose choice for something occurring or taking place.
This is the all-purpose choice for an event happening or taking place.
Use 發生 when the thing that arises is an event, situation, or problem that takes place.

examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 dim2 joeng2 faat3 sang1 gaa3

examples.english: These accidents occur all the time.
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 ji3 ngoi6 seng4 jat6 faat3 sang1

examples.english: We don't know when a problem may arise.
examples.traditional: 我哋唔知幾時會發生問題。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 zi1 gei2 si4 wui5 faat3 sang1 man6 tai4
